newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran Asseman Airlines launches Mashhad-Doha flight.
newsitem.headline: Iran Asseman Airlines launches Mashhad-Doha flight.

text.p: State-owned Iran Asseman Airlines has launched a twice-weekly service between the Qatari capital Doha and the holy city of Mashhad in northeastern Iran, the Iranian news agency IRNA said on Thursday.
It said the service, to be operated on Wednesdays and Fridays, was inaugurated on Wednesday.
The flights are primarily intended for pilgrims visiting a major Shi'ite Moslem shrine in Mashhad from the Gulf states where large numbers of Shi'ite Arabs and Iranians live, the agency added.
